about.title: About Me
about.p1: I'm Cheung Chiu Hei (Avin) — a full-stack developer and project coordinator with 5+ years of experience building CMS platforms, e-commerce sites, enterprise systems, and AI-powered products for public-sector, education, healthcare, and large-organisation clients.
about.p2: At xChain Solutions I lead project teams of 1–5 as sole consultant — delivering as developer, PM, cloud admin, and product planner for clients including MTR, City University, and hospital environments. Previously at BIGAZINES I was the sole developer maintaining 20+ production sites.
about.p3: I specialise in end-to-end delivery: requirements gathering, architecture, coding, Supabase migrations & RLS, deployment, and stakeholder handover. I leverage AI tools to accelerate prototyping while maintaining security governance and documentation standards.
about.p4: I'm particularly strong at standardising patterns across projects — Supabase Edge Functions, RAG pipelines with n8n and Qdrant, and AI-assisted workflows that cut repetitive work by 30–40%.
about.p5: I love turning complex requirements into clean, usable systems — and there's nothing quite like seeing clients actually use something I built.

bullets: Sole consultant in a 15-person organisation; leads project teams of 1–5 across development, PM, cloud admin, and product planning
Led full-cycle delivery of DMS, CMS, AMS, RAG applications, and AI agents for MTR, City University, hospital systems, and SharePoint integration
Standardised Supabase patterns (migrations, RLS, Edge Functions) across 8+ projects
Introduced AI-assisted workflows to accelerate delivery while maintaining security governance and documentation standards
Sole developer and technical lead in a 2–3 person team; designed, deployed, and maintained web platforms and Magento e-commerce sites
Independently developed 20+ websites/systems across .NET, PHP, Node.js, and Python on AWS and Azure
Served as PM: communicated with clients, designers, and operations teams to define scope, track progress, and ensure business alignment
Reduced repetitive development work by 30–40% through AI-assisted view-model building, API scaffolding, and UI prototyping

about.title: 關於我
about.p1: 我是張朝熙（Avin），有超過 5 年全端開發與專案協調經驗，為公營機構、教育、醫療及大型企業客戶建設 CMS、電商、企業系統及 AI 產品。
about.p2: 現於 xChain Solutions 擔任唯一顧問，帶領 1–5 人專案團隊，服務 MTR、城大、醫院系統及 SharePoint 整合等客戶。此前在 BIGAZINES 為唯一開發者，維護 20+ 個正式環境網站。
about.p3: 擅長全流程交付：需求收集、架構設計、開發、Supabase migrations & RLS、部署及交接。善用 AI 工具加速原型開發，同時維持安全治理與文件標準。
about.p4: 特別擅長跨專案標準化模式——Supabase Edge Functions、n8n + Qdrant RAG 管道，以及 AI 輔助 workflow，減少 30–40% 重複工作。
about.p5: 喜歡把複雜需求變成簡單好用的系統，也享受看到客戶樂於使用我做的東西。
